text:
Marta: Heads-up — our crm-webhooks DLQ count jumped this morning, ~1.6k events stuck since 04:00 UTC. Playbook triggers for onboarding/renewal are missing customers.
Alex: Any obvious pattern? same endpoint/error?
Marta: Sampling shows 502s from enrichment service. Logs: 
```
2026-03-23T04:12:01Z WARN webhook-handler failed to ack event id=abc123 status=502 body='Bad Gateway' attempts=3
2026-03-23T04:12:02Z INFO dlq.enqueue event=abc123 reason='upstream_502' queue=crm-webhooks-dlq
```
Jamal: I thought playbook-runner polls DLQ every 15m, but exponential backoff means many events never get retried quickly.
Marta: There is a separate DLQ processor (kafka-dlq-consumer) — it's in CrashLoopBackOff after the 03:50 deploy. cs-bot shows crash loops.
cs-bot: consumer/kafka-dlq-consumer restarted by k8s at 03:52 (image=rlrd/crm-dlq:v2.4.1)
Alex: Short-term: can we surface a manual-retry path for CS ops so renewal-window accounts aren't missed?
Rachel: We should expose a tiny UI for manual retries: fields event_id(s), reason, priority flag. Requeues into live topic with tag `manually_retried_by` and TTL=24h.
Vikram: Or a CLI in ops-tooling: `ops-tooling dlq requeue --queue crm-webhooks-dlq --filter 'renewal=true' --limit 200 --tag manual:csops`.
Marta: Both. Vikram makes CLI, Rachel coordinates CS access. Mid-term: add DLQ dashboard in Console with counts by reason and quick retry buttons.
Jamal: Also add per-event TTL and max_retries: propose max_retries=5, TTL=30d for normal, 24h if manual.
Alex: Ops checklist: 1) rollback kafka-dlq-consumer to prev image (Vikram) 2) add CLI `dlq requeue` (Vikram) 3) Rachel to draft temporary CS runbook & request access 4) Marta to export affected accounts and mark high-risk (renewal<30d) 5) Jamal to open Console telemetry follow-up.
Marta: I'll paste CSV shortly. Sample affected acct ids: acct_802, acct_901, acct_234 — playbook misses.
Rachel: Do we want approval for manual retries?
Alex: No approval for <=50 events, require approval for >50. Always keep audit logs.
Jamal: Add metadata origin=manual and maintain retry_history so evals can exclude these.
Vikram: Rollback scheduled 04:30 UTC. If rollback fails I'll trigger hotfix to restart DLQ consumer.
cs-bot: rollback job triggered by deploy-bot at 04:31 UTC, status=queued
Marta: Thanks. If anyone can help with requeues after rollback ping me. :raised_hands:
